Intution behind Random Forests - When in a dilemma about making a life
changing decision or say even purchasing a product we depend of opinion of
others so that we can get a holistic view. Random Forests does just that..It
builds multiple decision trees and predicts a value based on majority voting.
When we take opinion of others we look to find diverse opinion, else there is
a higher chance that the decision you take may not be right. Its the same with
Random Forests or any ensembling technique - have a diverse set of trees or
models so that your predictive power is higher hashtag#machinelearning
